CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

heading: Article 1
text:
Pasal 1

Dalam Peraturan Daerah ini yang dimaksud dengan:

1. Daerah adalah Kabupaten Gunung Mas.
2. Pemerintah Daerah adalah Bupati dan perangkat daerah sebagai unsur penyelenggara pemerintahan daerah.
3. Bupati adalah Bupati Gunung Mas.

4 . Perangkat Daerah adalah unsur pembantu Bupati dan Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Daerah dalam penyelenggaraan urusan pemerintahan yang menjadi kewenanga n Daerah.

5. Perlindungan Perempuan adalah segala upaya yang ditujukan untuk melindungi perempuan dan memberikan rasa aman dalam pemenuhan hak-haknya dengan memberikan perhatian yang konsisten dan sistematis yang ditujukan untuk mencapru kesetaraan gender.

6. Perlindungan Anal< adalah segala kegiatan untuk menjamin dan melindungi Anak dan hak-haknya agar dapat hidup, tumbuh, berkembang, dan berpartisipasi secara optimal sesuai dengan harkat dan martabat kemanusiaan, serta mendapat perlindungan dari Kekerasan dan diskriminasi.

7. Perempuan adalah sesorang yang berjenis kelamin perempuan. 8 . Anak adalah seseorang yang belum berusia 18 (delapan belas) tahun, termasuk anak yang masih dalam kandungan.

9 . Masyarakat adalah oran g perseorangan, kelompok Masyarakat, termasuk di dalamnya orang tua dan keluarga.

10. Pencegahan adalah segala upaya untuk menghilangkan segala resiko serta dampak buruk dari kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak.

11. Kekerasan adalah setiap perbuatan terhadap Anak yang berakibat timbulnya kesengsaraan atau penderitaan secara fis.ik, psikis, seksual, dan/ a tau penelantaran, termasuk ancaman untuk melakukan perbuatan, pemaksaan, a tau perampasan kemerdekaan secara melawan hu kum.

12. Forum Penanganan Korban Kekerasan Terhadap Perempuan dan Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat FPK2PA ad a lah forum koordinasi penanganan korban Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak yang penyelenggaraannya secara berjenjang di tingkat kabupaten dan kecamatan.

13. Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat P2TP2A adalah pusat pelayanan yang terintegrasi dalam upaya pemberdayaan Perempuan di berbagai bidang pembangunan, serta perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak dari berbagai jenis diskriminasi, dan tindak Kekerasan, termasuk perdagangan orang yang dibentuk oleh pemerintah atau berbasis Masyarakat.

14. Kelurahan/Desa Ramah Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat K/DRA adalah pem bangunan wilayah kelurahan/ desa yang menyatukan komitmen dan sumber daya pemerintah kelurah an/desa yang melibatkan Masyarakat dan dunia usaha yang berada di kelurahan/ desa dalam rangka mempromosikan, melindu n gi, memenuhi dan menghormati hak-hak anak, yang direncanakan secara sadar dan berkelanjutan.

Pasal 2

Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak diselenggarakan berdasarkan asas: a. penghormatan, pemenuhan, perlindungan, pemajuan, dan penegakan hak; dan

b. kepastian hukum.

Pasal 3

Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak dilaksanakan berdasarkan prinsip: a. responsif atas hak;

b. non diskriminasi;

c. menjaga kerahasiaan;

d. pemberdayaan; dan

e. partisipasi.

Pasal 4

Tujuan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak meliputi:

a. menjamin terpenuhinya hak;
b. memberikan keadilan dan kesetaraan hak;
c. memberikan perlindungan dan rasa aman; dan
d. melakukan pemberdayaan.

Pasal 5

Ruang lingkup Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak meliputi:

a. Perlindungan Perempuan;
b. Perlindungan Anak;
c. koordinasi dan kerja sama;
d. tanggung jawab Pemerintah Daerah;
e. peran serta Masyarakat;
f. pembinaan dan pengawasan;
g. evaluasi;
h. pelaporan; dan
i. pendanaan.

BAB II

PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN

Bagian Kesatu

Umum

Pasal 6

Perlindungan Perempuan meliputi:

a. pelayanan;
b. pemberdayaan;
c. pencegahan; dan
d. pemantauan.

Bagian Kedua

Pelayanan

Pasal 7

(1) Bentuk pelayanan Perlindungan Perempuan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 6 huruf a meliputi:

a. bantuan hukum;
b. pelayanan kesehatan;
c. pelayanan rehabilitasi sosial;
d. pelayanan pengaduan, konsultasi dan konseling; e . pelayanan reintegrasi sosial; dan
f. pelayanan bimbingan pra perkawinan.
(2) Pelayanan bimbingan pra perkawinan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) huruf f, dilaksanakan oleh setiap Perempuan yang akan melaksanakan perkawinan.
(3) Bimbingan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) dilalrukan untuk m emberikan pem ahaman dan pengetahuan mengenai ketahanan keluarga, kesehatan, psikologi, agam a, sosia l dan budaya.
(4) Bimbingan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (3) dilaksanakan oleh Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak.
(5) Dalam m elaksanakan bimbingan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (4) Perangkat Daerah dapat m engikutsertakan: a . instansi terkait;
b. tokoh agama; dan
c. tokoh adat.
(6) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai tata cara pelayanan Perlindungan Perempuan diatur dengan Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is Gunung Mas Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent and regional apparatus as elements of regional government administration.
3. Regent is the Regent of Gunung Mas.

4 . Regional Apparatus is the auxiliary element of the Regent and Regional House of Representatives in the administration of governmental affairs that are the authority of the Region.

5. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.

6. Protection of Children is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and worth, and receive protection from Violence and discrimination.

7. Women is a person who is female. 8 . Children is a person who is not yet 18 (eighteen) years old, including children who are still in the womb.

9 . Society is individuals, community groups, including parents and families therein.

10. Prevention is all efforts to eliminate all risks and adverse impacts of violence against Women and Children.

11. Violence is any act against a Child that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.

12. Forum for Handling Victims of Violence Against Women and Children, hereinafter abbreviated as FPK2PA, is a coordinating forum for handling victims of Violence against Women and Children whose implementation is tiered at the regency and district levels.

13. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Children, hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A, is an integrated service center in efforts to empower Women in various fields of development, as well as protect Women and Children from various types of discrimination and acts of Violence, including trafficking in persons established by the government or community-based.

14. Child-Friendly Village/Sub-District, hereinafter abbreviated as K/DRA, is the development of a village/sub-district area that unites the commitment and resources of the village/sub-district government involving the community and business world located in the village/sub-district in order to promote, protect, fulfill and respect children's rights, which are planned consciously and sustainably.

Article 2

Protection of Women and Children is organized based on the principles of: a. respect, fulfillment, protection, advancement, and enforcement of rights; and

b. legal certainty.

Article 3

Protection of Women and Children is implemented based on the principles of: a. responsive to rights;

b. non-discrimination;

c. maintaining confidentiality;

d. empowerment; and

e. participation.

Article 4

The objectives of Protection of Women and Children include:

a. ensuring the fulfillment of rights;
b. providing justice and equality of rights;
c. providing protection and a sense of security; and
d. conducting empowerment.

Article 5

The scope of Protection of Women and Children includes:

a. Protection of Women;
b. Protection of Children;
c. coordination and cooperation;
d. responsibilities of the Regional Government;
e. community participation;
f. guidance and supervision;
g. evaluation;
h. reporting; and
i. funding.

CHAPTER II

PROTECTION OF WOMEN

Part One

General

Article 6

Protection of Women includes:

a. services;
b. empowerment;
c. prevention; and
d. monitoring.

Part Two

Services

Article 7

(1) Forms of services for Protection of Women as referred to in Article 6 letter a include:

a. legal aid;
b. health services;
c. social rehabilitation services;
d. complaint, consultation and counseling services; e . social reintegration services; and
f. pre-marriage guidance services.
(2) Pre-marriage guidance services as referred to in paragraph (1) letter f are carried out by every Woman who will carry out marriage.
(3) Guidance as referred to in paragraph (2) is carried out to provide understanding and knowledge regarding family resilience, health, psychology, religion, social and culture.
(4) Guidance as referred to in paragraph (3) is carried out by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of women's empowerment and Child Protection.
(5) In carrying out guidance as referred to in paragraph (4), the Regional Apparatus may include: a . relevant agencies;
b. religious leaders; and
c. traditional leaders.
(6) Further provisions regarding the procedures for services for Protection of Women are regulated by Regent Regulation.

translated_text:
Article 14

(1) Prevention of violations of Children's rights is carried out by the Regional Government and the Community.

(2) Prevention of violations of Children's rights carried out by the Regional Government as referred to in paragraph I]) is carried out by:

a. forming a work network;
b. conducting coordination, integration, synchronization of Prevention based on partnership patterns with the Community, private sector, community non-governmental organizations; and
c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to Child Protection.
(3) Prevention of violations of Children's rights carried out by the Community as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by: a . increasing the productivity of Children; b . developing the self-potential of Children;
c. preventing pregnancy at a young age;
d. reducing maternal and infant mortality rates; and
e. preventing the occurrence of domestic Violence.
(4) The formation of a work network as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a includes the Regional Government's work partners in implementing Prevention of rights violations in the form of family partners.
(5) Further provisions regarding the Prevention of violations of Children's rights as referred to in paragraph (3) are regulated in a Regent Regulation.

Pasal 16

(1) Penyelenggaraan koordinasi dan kerjasama terhadap Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak bertujuan untuk:

a. meningkatkan upaya pemenuhan hak Perempuan dan Anak; b . meningkatkan hubungan kerja yang sinergi dan harmonis; dan c. memperoleh data dan informasi dalam penyelenggaraan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak.
(2) Dalam rangka mencapai tujuan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) Pemerintah Daerah bekerjasama dengan:
a. Pemerintah Daerah lain; b . instansi terkait;
c. lembaga non pemerintah; d . perguruan tinggi; dan
e. lembaga swadaya Masyarakat.
(3) Kerja sama sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) meliputi: a . pertukaran data dan informasi;
b. sosialisasi atau ceramah penyuluhan hukum;
c. rehabilitasi korban tindak Kekerasan; dan
d. pemulangan dan reintegrasi sosial.
translated_text:
Article 16

(1) The implementation of coordination and cooperation on the Protection of Women and Children aims to:

a. improve efforts to fulfill the rights of Women and Children; b . improve synergistic and harmonious working relationships; and c. obtain data and information in the implementation of Protection of Women and Children.
(2) In order to achieve the objectives as referred to in paragraph (1) the Regional Government cooperates with:
a. other Regional Governments; b . related agencies;
c. non-governmental institutions; d . universities; and
e. Community non-governmental organizations.
(3) Cooperation as referred to in paragraph (2) includes: a . exchange of data and information;
b. socialization or legal counseling lectures;
c. rehabilitation of victims of acts of Violence; and
d. repatriation and social reintegration.

Pasal 18

(1) Pemerintah Daerah dalam melaksanakan tanggung jawab pelembagaan Pengarusutamaan gender sebagaimana dimaksud da1am Pasal 17 ayat (3) huruf b terhadap Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak wajib menyelenggarakan sistem informasi data Perempuan dan Anak.

(2) Sistem Informasi data Perempuan sebagaimana dimaksud ayat (1) merupakan bagian yang tidak terpisahkan dengan sistem informasi data Anak.

(3) Sistem informasi Perempuan dan Anak sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) diatur lebih lanjut dengan Peraturan Bupati.

(4) Pengarusutamaan gender sebagaimana dimaksud da1am ayat (1) diselenggarakan sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang undangan.

Pasa1 19

(1) Dalam rangka efektifitas penyelenggaraan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak, Pemerintah Daerah harus melakukan koordinasi lintas sektora1 dengan lem baga terkait.

(2) Dalam penyelenggaraan koordinasi Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak sebagaimana dima1<sud pada ayat (1) Bupati menetapkan tim koordinasi Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak.

(3) Dalam kegiatan forum koordinasi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) tim koordinasi Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak bertugas: a . menyiapkan bahan yang diperlukan terkait penyelenggaraan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak; dan b . menyampaikan hasil, hambatan, dan solusi yang dilakukan untuk mengatasi hambatan dalam penyelenggaraan Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anal<.

(4) Forum koordinasi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (3) diJakukan secara berkala, paling sedikit 2 (dua) kali dalam 1 (satu) tahun.
translated_text:
Article 18

(1) The Regional Government in carrying out the responsibility of institutionalizing Gender mainstreaming as referred to in Article 17 paragraph (3) letter b regarding the Protection of Women and Children is obliged to organize an information system for data on Women and Children.

(2) The Women's data information system as referred to in paragraph (1) is an integral part of the Children's data information system.

(3) The Women's and Children's information system as referred to in paragraph (2) is further regulated by Regent Regulation.

(4) Gender mainstreaming as referred to in paragraph (1) is organized in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

Artic1e 19

(1) In order to ensure the effectiveness of the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children, the Regional Government must conduct cross-sectoral coordination with related institutions.

(2) In the implementation of coordination of the Protection of Women and Children as referred to in paragraph (1) the Regent establishes a coordination team for the Protection of Women and Children.

(3) In the coordination forum activities as referred to in paragraph (2) the coordination team for the Protection of Women and Children has the duty to: a . prepare materials needed related to the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children; and b . convey results, obstacles, and solutions carried out to overcome obstacles in the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children.

(4) The coordination forum as referred to in paragraph (3) is conducted periodically, at least 2 (two) times in 1 (one) year.

heading: Article 20
text:
Pasal 20

(1) Pemerintah Daerah berkewajiban dan bertanggung jawab untuk m ela1<sanakan upaya Pencegahan terjadinya Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 17 ayat (3) huruf e dan ayat (4) huruf i dilakukan dalam bentuk

a. mengumpulkan data dan menyelenggarakan sistem informasi Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak korban Kekerasan;

b. melakukan pendidikan tentang nilai anti Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak; dan l c . melakukan sosialisasi peraturan perundang-undangan yang berkaitan dengan pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak korban Kekerasan.

(2) Pemerintah Daerah berkewajiban dan bertanggung jawab untuk menyediakan dan menyelenggarakan layanan bagi korban dalam bentuk:

a. mendirikan dan menyelenggarakan lembaga pelayanan teknis untuk korban dengan melibatkan unsur Masyarakat; dan
b. mendorong kepedulian Masyarakat akan pentingnya pelindungan terhadap korban Kekerasan.
translated_text:
Article 20

(1) The Regional Government is obliged and responsible to carry out Prevention efforts against the occurrence of Violence against Women and Children as referred to in Article 17 paragraph (3) letter e and paragraph (4) letter i carried out in the form of

a. collecting data and organizing an information system for the Protection of Women and Children victims of Violence;

b. conducting education on anti-Violence values against Women and Children; and l c . conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to the empowerment of Women and Protection of Children victims of Violence.

(2) The Regional Government is obliged and responsible to provide and organize services for victims in the form of:

a. establishing and organizing technical service institutions for victims by involving Community elements; and
b. encouraging Community awareness of the importance of protection for victims of Violence.

Pasal 27

(1) Dalam rangka melindungi dan menjamin hak Perempuan dan Anak dari tindak Kekerasan dibentuk FPK2PA.

(2) FPK2PA sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) terdiri dari: a. FPK2 PA Daer ah;

b. FPK2PA kecamatan; dan

c. FPK2PA kelurahan/ desa.

(3) Pembentukan FPK2PA Daerah sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) huruf a ditetapkan oleh Bupati.

(4) Pembentukan FPK2PA kecamatan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2) huruf b ditetapkan oleh camat.

translated_text:
Article 27

(1) In order to protect and guarantee the rights of Women and Children from acts of Violence, FPK2PA shall be established.

(2) FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of: a. Regional FPK2PA;

b. Sub-district FPK2PA; and

c. Village FPK2PA.

(3) The establishment of Regional FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a shall be determined by the Regent.

(4) The establishment of sub-district FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b shall be determined by the sub-district head.

(5) The establishment of Village FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (2) letter c shall be determined by the village head. (6) Further provisions regarding FPK2PA as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated in a Regent Regulation.

translated_text:
Article 31

(1) The Regent is obliged to provide guidance and supervision of the Protection of Women and children.

(2) The implementation of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children Protection.

(3) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall include:

a. coordination;
b. mentoring;
c. education and training;
d. monitoring and evaluation; and
e. reporting.
(4) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) to realize the objectives of Women and Children Protection in accordance with the norms, standards, procedures and criteria implemented by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children Protection.
(5) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out with professional and transparent principles.
(6) In carrying out guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children Protection must report periodically to the Regent.
(7) In terms of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (2), the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children Protection may cooperate and coordinate with other Regional Apparatus, the Community, agencies and/or related organizational institutions.

translated_text:
Article 32

(1) Evaluation of Women and Children Protection shall be carried out based on documents of service implementation, empowerment, Prevention, fulfillment and monitoring results of the implementation of Women and Children Protection.

(2) The implementation of evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's empowerment and Children Protection.

(3) Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall include process, impact and outcome evaluation.

(4) The evaluation results as referred to in paragraph (3) shall constitute material for the Regional Apparatus to prepare a report which shall subsequently be submitted to the Regent.

(5) Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (4) shall be carried out at least 1 (one) time in 1 (one) year.

(6) Further provisions regarding evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

TENTANG

PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK

I. UMUM

Anak adalah masa depan bangsa dan generasi penerus cita cita bangsa, sehingga setiap Anak berhak atas kelangsungan hidup, tumbuh dan berkembang, berpartisipasi serta berhak atas perlindungan dari tindak Kekerasan dan diskriminasi serta hak sipil dan kebebasan.

Demikian pula Perempuan yang berperan sebagai ibu yang melahirkan anak-anak yang sehat, kuat, tangguh, berakhlak mulia, potensial dan berkualitas. Melalui peranan Perempuan dalam keluarga, Masyarakat dan negara akan lahir generasi genarasi tangguh yang akan melanjutkan cita-cita bangsa. Undang-Undang Dasar Negara Republik Indonesia Tahun 1945 khususnya Pasal 27 ayat ( 1) yang menyatakan bahwa "Segala warga negara bersamaan kedudukannya di dalam hukum dan pemerintahan dan wajib menjunjung tinggi hukum dan pemerintahan itu dengan tidak ada kecualinya". Walaupun Undang-Undang Dasar Negara Republik Indonesia Tahun 1945 telah menjamin persamaan kedudukan di setiap warga negara, namun hingga saat ini Perempuan dan Anak masih mengalami berbagai hambatan untuk memperoleh hak-haknya hampir di segala bidang.

Di sisi lain, Perempuan memiliki kebutuhan khusus dibandingkan laki-laki, sehingga sesuai dengan kodratnya tersebut, dalam kondisi tertentu Pemerintah Daerah harus dapat menjamin haknya dipenuhi sesuai dengan kebutuhan tersebut. Sedangkan anak, mereka adalah amanah dan karunia Tuhan Yang Maha Esa, dimana dalam dirinya melekat harkat dan martabat sebagai manusia seutuhnya. Mengingat posisi dan harapan kepada anak sebagai potensi dan masa depan bangsa sehingga anak patut mendapat perhatian dari semua pihak agar anak dapat tumbuh dan berkembang secara wajar serta terhindar dari perlakuan dan tindakan yang salah, Kekerasan, diskirminasi yang akan merusak perkembangan anak baik fisik, mental maupun sosial anak. Untuk itu anak perlu mendapatkan kesempatan seluas-luasnya untuk dapat tumbuh dan berkembang secara optimal, baik secara fisik, mental, sosial dan akhlak yang mulia.

Berpangkal tolak dari hal tersebut, diperlukan suatu regulasi yang menjadi pedoman bagi semua pihak, khususnya Pemerintah Daerah dalam menjamin terselenggaranya Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak di Kabupaten Gunung Mas sesuai dengan kewenangan yang dimiliki yang tercantum dalam Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2014 tentang Pemerintahan Daerah, maupun peraturan perundang-undangan lain yang mengatur tentang Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Children are the future of the nation and the next generation of the nation's ideals, so that every Child has the right to survival, to grow and develop, to participate and has the right to protection from acts of Violence and discrimination as well as civil rights and freedoms.

Likewise Women who play the role of mothers who give birth to healthy, strong, resilient, virtuous, potential and quality children. Through the role of Women in the family, Society and the state will be born resilient generations who will continue the ideals of the nation. The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, particularly Article 27 paragraph (1) which states that "All citizens have equal standing in law and government and are obliged to uphold the law and government without any exception". Although the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has guaranteed equal standing for every citizen, until now Women and Children still experience various obstacles to obtaining their rights in almost all fields.

On the other hand, Women have special needs compared to men, so in accordance with their nature, in certain conditions the Regional Government must be able to guarantee that their rights are fulfilled according to those needs. Whereas children, they are the mandate and grace of God Almighty, in whom is inherent dignity and worth as a complete human being. Considering the position and expectations for children as the potential and future of the nation, children deserve attention from all parties so that children can grow and develop normally and are protected from wrong treatment and actions, Violence, discrimination that will damage the child's development both physically, mentally and socially. For that reason children need to get the widest possible opportunity to be able to grow and develop optimally, both physically, mentally, socially and with noble character.

Starting from this matter, a regulation is needed that becomes a guideline for all parties, especially the Regional Government in guaranteeing the implementation of Protection of Women and Children in Gunung Mas Regency in accordance with the authority possessed as contained in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, as well as other laws and regulations that regulate the Protection of Women and Children.

Hurufc Yang dimaksud tanggung jawab perlindungan hak Perempuan di bidang Politik adalah Pemerintah Daerah bertanggung jawab untuk dapat memfasilitasi peningkatan pengetahuan Perempuan dalam bidang politik melalui sosialisasi untuk meningkatkan kesadaran atas hak Perempuan dan partisipasi Perempuan di bidang politik, mendorong peningkatan keterlibatan Perempuan dalam organisasi kemasyarakatan dan kegiatan pengambilan keputusan di lingkungan Pemerintah Daerah, mendorong pembentukan organisasi/forum Perempuan.

Huruf d Yang dimaksud tanggung jawab perlindungan hak Perempuan dan Anak di bidang hukum adalah Pemerintah Daerah bertanggung jawab untuk memfasilitasi peningkatan pengetahuan dan kesadaran hukum bagi Perempuan dan Anak, mendorong pembentukan organisasi yang memberikan layanan hukum secara gratis bagi Perempuan dan Anak.

Huruf e Yang dimaksud tanggung jawab perlindungan hak Perempuan dan Anak di bidang ekonomi adalah Pemerintah Daerah bertanggung jawab untuk memfasilitasi Perempuan dan Anak dalam mendapatkan akses dan fasilitas di bidang ekonomi, memfasilitasi Perempuan dalam usaha meningkatkan perekonomian keluarga, memberikan bantuan permodalan atau pelatihan bagi Perempuan.

Huruff Cukup jelas. Huruf g Yang dimaksud tanggung jawab perlindungan hak Perempuan dan anak di bidang sosial adalah Pemerintah Daerah bertanggung jawab untuk memfasilitasi Perempuan dan Anak dalam mendapatkan akses dan fasilitas di bidang sosial.
